'''Shewski Echo Base Regeneration (EBO)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Shewski]]
* '''Published:''' 2 December 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Hoth-L-hothmainpowergenerators.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Hoth Main Power Generators (1st M EchoBase.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck aims to get a quick victory through drains in space.  It is helped by being able to regenerate and retrieve on a regular basis.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

I have just decided to get back into the game, after letting it gather dust when I left for college, four years ago.  (Jabba’s Palace just came out)  I started picking up cards on eBay this past summer.  I am going to start posting some decks and try to get feedback on where they can be tuned/tweaked/scrapped.  I have all cards up to SE, most of Tatooine and Theed Palace, a few from Endor, DS2, and none of EPP and Coruscant.

Thanks!

This deck aims to get out EBO quickly and start draining in space.  I included more 'mains' and ships rather than the swarm EBO decks so that I could use my Bacta Tank and D&R; to their fullest.  Once I get some Endor/Coruscant cards, I want to include Endor and Naboo, taking out Kiffex and Kessel, so that I can get to all major battlegrounds.  I include a minor hit squad of Han, Chewie and the Jedi in case someone tries to invade Hoth and cancel EBO.  Han, armed with his gun, will especially be good at dealing with Undercover spies.  The Princess, Figrin, and Luke will all retrieve 1 per turn if they are out.  I also am considering leaving out the two Out of Nowhere's and adding Hyper Escape or Rebel Barrier.  A (V) Dodonna may be of use once I get some of the unique pilots/ships that are in DS2.  Should I trash Princess and throw in Boushh? (can she be targeted by Reflection)?

Let me know what you think!

EDIT- Revelation, please see the first section of my strategy paragraphs.  They are missing since I simply don't own them!

EDIT2- Larry, I only have three Echo sites since A New Secret Base can download them before I could lose them.  Thank you for the generous rating.  I was considering using Boussh instead of the Princess, so as her UNdercover mode, her holding a Saber is not worth it- Ditto since I use V Luke to retrieve and pilot.  I don't anticipate needed an V Fusion Gen since my power is already decent at space sites, I'm usually at 9 + destiny and I can lose them to the healing effects no problem.  Redemption parked at Hoth lets me effectively deal with invading DSers.
